parameters.content:
## XRE Bitrix24 Management Intelligence v5

Yeni: `ask_crm` doğal dil sorgusu. Personel adı (Merve, Tuğba, Zeliha, Arda vb.) Bitrix aktif kullanıcı listesinden otomatik eşleştirilir.

Örnek: `{"action":"ask_crm","question":"Merve bugün kimleri aradı?"}`

Destek: bugün, dün, son N gün; arama/gelen-giden/cevapsız, tamamlanmış/açık aktiviteler, ekip özeti.

Not: `COMPLETED=Y` geçmiş UI buton tıklamasını tek başına kanıtlamaz. Kesin buton audit'i ileriye dönük event log gerektirir.

Geçmiş UI tıklamaları geriye dönük kesinleştirilemez.'}}];

## V7 FIXED
- Audit webhook artık Immediately/On Received yanıt verir.
- Kopuk zincir düzeltildi: Webhook → Normalize → crm.activity.get → Prepare → PostgreSQL.
- Audit webhook shared-secret kontrolü yapar.
- PostgreSQL xre_activity_events tablosunu otomatik oluşturur.
- Exact completion audit yalnızca gözlenen COMPLETED N→Y geçişlerini döndürür.
- ask_crm ve mevcut CRM sorguları korunmuştur.

Önemli: Exact audit yalnızca audit sistemi aktif olduktan sonra yakalanan geçişleri kesin olarak gösterebilir.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xre_activity_events (
  event_key text PRIMARY KEY,
  activity_id bigint NOT NULL,
  event text NOT NULL,
  event_type text,
  completed text,
  responsible_id bigint,
  author_id bigint,
  editor_id bigint,
  owner_type_id bigint,
  owner_id bigint,
  subject text,
  provider_id text,
  provider_type_id text,
  direction text,
  bitrix_last_updated timestamptz,
  received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE xre_activity_events
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_type text;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xre_activity_events_activity
  ON xre_activity_events(activity_id, received_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xre_activity_events_received
  ON xre_activity_events(received_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xre_activity_events_resp
  ON xre_activity_events(responsible_id, received_at);

INSERT INTO xre_activity_events(
  event_key,
  activity_id,
  event,
  event_type,
  completed,
  responsible_id,
  author_id,
  editor_id,
  owner_type_id,
  owner_id,
  subject,
  provider_id,
  provider_type_id,
  direction,
  bitrix_last_updated,
  received_at,
  payload
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2::bigint,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  NULLIF($6,'')::bigint,
  NULLIF($7,'')::bigint,
  NULLIF($8,'')::bigint,
  NULLIF($9,'')::bigint,
  NULLIF($10,'')::bigint,
  $11,
  $12,
  $13,
  $14,
  NULLIF($15,'')::timestamptz,
  $16::timestamptz,
  $17::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO UPDATE SET
  event_type = EXCLUDED.event_type,
  completed = EXCLUDED.completed,
  responsible_id = EXCLUDED.responsible_id,
  editor_id = EXCLUDED.editor_id,
  payload = EXCLUDED.payload
RETURNING
  activity_id,
  event,
  event_type,
  completed,
  responsible_id,
  editor_id,
  received_at;

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    e.*,
    LAG(e.completed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.activity_id
      ORDER BY e.received_at, e.created_at, e.event_key
    ) AS previous_completed
  FROM xre_activity_events e
),
transitions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ordered
  WHERE event = 'ONCRMACTIVITYUPDATE'
    AND completed = 'Y'
    AND previous_completed = 'N'
)
SELECT
  activity_id,
  event,
  event_type,
  previous_completed,
  completed AS current_completed,
  responsible_id,
  author_id,
  editor_id,
  owner_type_id,
  owner_id,
  subject,
  provider_id,
  provider_type_id,
  direction,
  bitrix_last_updated,
  received_at,
  payload
FROM transitions
WHERE received_at >= $1::timestamptz
  AND received_at <= $2::timestamptz
  AND ($3 = '' OR responsible_id = $3::bigint)
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;
